detect: Relocation section '[^']+' at offset 0x[0-9a-fA-F]+ contains \d+ entr
parser:
import re

TITLE = re.compile(r"^Relocation section '(?P<section>[^']+)' at offset (?P<offset>0x[0-9a-fA-F]+) contains (?P<n>\d+) entr")
HEAD = re.compile(r"^\s*Offset\s+Info\s+Type")
ROW = re.compile(r"^(?P<off>[0-9a-fA-F]+)\s+(?P<info>[0-9a-fA-F]+)\s+(?P<type>\S+)(?:\s+(?P<rest>.*?))?\s*$")
FULL = re.compile(r"^(?P<val>[0-9a-fA-F]+)\s+(?P<name>.*?)\s+(?P<sign>[+-])\s+(?P<add>[0-9a-fA-F]+)$")
ONLY = re.compile(r"^(?P<add>[0-9a-fA-F]+)$")
NAMED = re.compile(r"^(?P<val>[0-9a-fA-F]+)\s+(?P<name>.+)$")

def parse(lines):
    records = []
    used = []
    skip = []
    section = ''
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        m = TITLE.match(line)
        if m:
            section = m.group('section')
            used.append(i)
            continue
        if HEAD.match(line) or line.strip().startswith('There are no relocations'):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = ROW.match(line)
        if not m:
            continue
        rest = m.group('rest') or ''
        val = ''
        name = ''
        add = ''
        f = FULL.match(rest)
        if f:
            val = f.group('val')
            name = f.group('name')
            add = ('-' if f.group('sign') == '-' else '') + f.group('add')
        else:
            o = ONLY.match(rest)
            if o:
                add = o.group('add')
            else:
                n = NAMED.match(rest)
                if n:
                    val = n.group('val')
                    name = n.group('name')
                else:
                    name = rest
        records.append({'Section': section, 'Offset': m.group('off'), 'Info': m.group('info'), 'Type': m.group('type'), 'Sym. Value': val, 'Sym. Name': name, 'Addend': add})
        used.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if records:
        blocks.append({'name': 'relocations', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': records})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
